name: Geo Treasure Compass
description:
A compass that can be used in Liyue to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
The land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found.
fullDescription: A handy tool used to locate nearby chests and relevant clues. The land of Geo is rich with valuable resources, with treasures hidden throughout the mountains and wilderness just waiting to be found. Every Treasure Hoarder around dreams of getting their hands on a magical compass like this.
